title: Extrinsic Evaluation of Cultural Competence in Large Language Models
findings: When prompted with specific nationalities, models generate culturally relevant vocabulary which can include religious terms. For example, outputs for India included 'hindu' in a political context and 'temple' in stories, demonstrating the models' ability to associate religious concepts with national identity.
